decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already updates the FAQ's no-referral explanations to six tickets and a commission allocated by weighted draw among eligible NFT owners.
The landing-page copy still combines a missing referral with one $900 entry assigned to a random owner, so its no-referral branch must reflect the new six-ticket weighted-draw rule.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: After 9 buys, why do only 8 tickets exist? Even a referral-free purchase should create 6 tickets and commission, with both allocated by weighted draw.

value_updates.referral_reward_copy_requirement: State that only NFTs confirmed before checkout are valid referrals; an accepted referral gives the chosen referrer a $25 credit and entry into the $2,000 reward drawing; a referral-free purchase creates six tickets and a commission, with both allocated by weighted draw among eligible NFT owners; and a rejected referral retains the existing $18 commission and $900 draw-entry explanation.

decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already changes no-referral issuance to six tickets, changes recipient selection to a weighted draw among eligible NFT owners, and removes the obsolete one-entry key.
A same-message MODIFY already changes the no-referral commission recipient selection to a weighted draw among eligible NFT owners; the source does not change the commission amount.
The source changes allocation of no-referral rewards, not the mint price or commission amounts represented by this Requirement.
The source concerns purchases without a referral and does not change commission behavior for an accepted coded referral.
The source changes ticket creation for referral-free purchases and does not change entries awarded to a chosen referrer when a referral is accepted.
The no-referral reward allocation decision does not affect landing-page book-cover placement, size, or cropping.
The source does not change the current or planned product name.
The source changes rewards for a referral-free purchase but does not change which referral identifiers are valid or the self-referral restriction.
The source does not affect NFT image, metadata, dashboard, wallet, or contract-scope rendering behavior.
The source does not change the badge set, badge icons, or dashboard badge layout.
